findings.title: Mutations remain unguarded by `requirePermission` in several routers (including a governance state transition)
findings.note: governance submit (governance.ts:190) and all client-onboarding mutations are guarded, but the residual set is unchanged: projects.ts:869,934,971,1010,1039,1084,1185,1220,1252; assets.ts:366; findings.ts:469 carry only org scoping (assertProjectInOrg/loadOwned), no requirePermission.

findings.title: External integration syncs report success while dropping items, and `jsm-sync` has no HTTP retry
findings.note: jsm-sync.ts:234 returns ok:false on per-item errors and retries transient HTTP; stripe-reconcile.ts:440-451 fails the run on drift or per-item errors; jira-sync.ts:206 still returns {ok:true} after counting errors (114-122,184).

findings.title: Published error-handling contract contradicts the implementation (codes, 422, and `request_id`)
findings.note: docs/API_ERROR_HANDLING.md:19-67 documents the implemented flat envelope, 400-not-422 and X-Request-ID; middleware/request-id.ts:18 emits the header.

findings.title: SDK retries unsafe requests without an `Idempotency-Key` (duplicate creates on transient failure)
findings.note: packages/sdk/src/client.ts:213-220,337-341 mint one Idempotency-Key per logical call outside the retry loop.

findings.title: Outbound webhook dispatcher uses a non-atomic idempotency check (duplicate deliveries under concurrency)
findings.note: lib/webhook-dispatcher.ts:182-200 atomic Redis SET NX claim per endpoint + upsert delivery; tests cover concurrent-duplicate collapse.

findings.title: Search falls through to an unscoped cross-tenant query
findings.note: routes/search.ts:106-126 scopes every query to req.orgScope and substitutes ['__none__'] on an empty scope.

findings.title: OpenAPI schema is public and the Swagger UI is blocked by CSP
findings.note: routes/docs.ts:21-39 404s in production; nonce/SRI wiring unchanged; node scripts/openapi-audit.js -> 0 MISSING (exit 0).

findings.title: Minor contract inconsistencies (`rateLimitByUser` non-enveloped 429, capped raw-array lists, no `request_id`)
findings.note: X-Request-ID is emitted, but 429 is still express-rate-limit's plain-text default (middleware/rate-limit.ts:27-38 has no envelope handler) while docs/API_RATE_LIMITING.md:56-70 documents an enveloped RATE_LIMITED body; idempotency 400/409 (middleware/idempotency.ts:30,69) and timeout 408 (middleware/request-timeout.ts:37) are also non-enveloped.

findings.title: OpenAPI artifact is not bound to a commit and the CI audit warns (not fails) on documented-but-missing routes
findings.note: openapi-audit.js fails on MISSING (ran: 0 missing, exit 0) and EXTRA remains a warning without an allowlist; docs/openapi.yaml has no commit binding (header lines 1-4 name only the generator).

findings.title: Realtime client has no reconnect path; server emits `auth_expired` with no documented client handling
findings.note: apps/web/components/NotificationBell.tsx:112-188 bounded reconnect with backoff and terminal auth_expired -> sign-in.

findings.title: `/metrics` is fully public when `METRICS_TOKEN` is unset
findings.note: app.ts:153-160 404s /metrics unless METRICS_TOKEN is configured and presented.

findings.title: Batch Jira/JSM/M365 sync tasks are registered but never dispatched (no scheduler or enqueue path)
findings.note: routes/admin.ts:127-169 POST /admin/integration-syncs enqueues jira/jsm/m365 batch tasks.

findings.title: M365 calendar sync recreates a calendar event for every task on each run (duplicate events, no idempotency)
findings.note: worker/tasks/m365-calendar-sync.ts:103-139 PATCHes the persisted m365_event_id and stores new ids.

findings.title: M365 inbound webhook acknowledges but only processes the first notification of a batch
findings.note: routes/webhooks.ts:881-947 iterates every notification in value[] with per-notification dedup/audit.

findings.title: GET /dynamic-forms/export.csv ignores format and returns JSON, contradicting the OpenAPI contract
findings.note: routes/dynamic-client-forms-builder.ts:71-85 calls res.json(result) while exportDynamicForms (services/dynamic-client-forms-builder.ts:327-356) never builds CSV and ignores options.format; docs/openapi.yaml:4102-4107 advertises 'Export dynamic forms (CSV)'. No web call site, so latent. New finding (P3).
